_note: Next Top Comic (DESIGN.md): stand-up mini-game using the dialogue system in Monkey Island insult-sword-fighting structure (Sarah Silverman). Just horrible unfunny setup / punchline pairings, but the women in the audience think it's hilarious. 'setups' is the set, in order: each is {"setup": text, "punchlines": [text, ...]}; the player picks a punchline. Every setup is spoken by Silverman, so each is one of her own lines, verbatim from data/quotes/silverman.json. The punchlines are the player's, and per Story Structure (Camera 2: cruise dialogue is lifted almost verbatim from TED talks, Lean In, Women's March posters) each is a Women's March sign, verbatim from data/empowerment_lines.json. None of them fit the setup; that is the joke, and the audience laughs anyway. The set escalates toward the end of the voyage. When the setups run out the set ends and comic_done is written.
